notes.title: Updated Stats Guide
notes.notes: [h1]A better guide[/h1][p]Basically instead of giving you a minimum, I'm giving you ranges. I guess a lot of people wanna max out stats for absolute assurance, but that's not how it works, darling![/p][p]Does this mean that if you exceed a max Affection of 95 you're gonna miss out on the nympho ending? Nah, it's not that messed up. The ending is determined by a certain curve and these ranges are basically the best to have your stats within to ensure the ending. You gotta think of 8 stats at once so it's normal to lose track.[/p][h1]So there are 2 modes to ending calculation:[/h1][h3][b]unique(default):[/b] uses stats as a reference + curve + checks if you already got an ending, so it gives a new unique one if close enough[/h3][h3][b]stats:[/b] uses stats as a reference + curve[/h3][p][/p][p]basically I wanted this game to be an experience of dating mina in many dimensions. so it was a tough choice, because I know conventionally most developers would prefer stats only endings. but i rather that be an optional choice because like Liminal Void, I just want the players to get the most out of it instead of "studying" for my game or needing a walkthrough...their eyes away from the monitor, or Landmine tabbed down.[/p][h3][u][i]oh snap okay i'll get to windowed mode on a future update[/i][/u][/h3][p][/p][p]and stats mode, as the name implies, means the game does not care if you got 4 netorare endings in a row. You get a repeat ending if the stats align well with it. that's basically how it goes. [/p][p][/p][p]is it possible to get tsundere ending in old school mode with stats calculation? [b]inshallah[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I know there are bound to be disagreements for the stats! but we all have different eyes and as I was determining the ranges, I factored in a lot when I made them. I know there are people wondering how resentment could even exist in a reformed ending, or allowed in a pure love ending. Why such high dependency in an ending meant for betrayal?[/p][p][/p][p]love is crazy! or whatever it is that makes us think of love, it can make us lose ourselves.[/p][p][/p][p]so here are the new stats guide in the latest update! I hope you enjoy the game! And please leave a review for the algorithm gods as it helps with visibility and such. This was a surprise release with no marketing and while that was cool it was pretty dumb in retrospect lol. this game was a spur of the moment to see if i could really make games so I will be cherishing it more! I'll be making a major update next week![/p][p][/p][p]I love you all![/p][p]-jeijei[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583574/a4c215497bf819bf0a39fd72d2303f75d7620e62.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Landmine Princess will be out May 23
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583574/b3396c3a1a921eb01301092f06628f9efe96c7fa.png[/img]

[url=https://youtu.be/Oelu_FB3MPw]What is it?[/url] A dating sim, but more of an experimental film type of game. Basically your story consists of 5 dates out of 32 possible dating scenarios with Mina. When you get down to it, you're basically having small talk with your date, and occasionally she drops lore or heavy questions. As in, one minute you're talking about cats at a cat cafe, the next she asks if dreaming of exes counts as emotional cheating. Or something like that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583574/e82145110bafb9a8eb0a401ff7742d6f91e2aa09.jpg[/img]

I threw in all the information you need to play the game in the options menu. I was never a "take notes" or 999 saves type of player. So the way I made this game is that it requires no external walkthroughs. Plus everything is in the stats and the endings can get weighted. Why? Because the game's premise isn't about the perfect date.

You can give gifts but there's only one button for it. And occasionally, the wrong gift might make her resent you. I give agency, but always throw in risk. The whole point of the game is to focus on the dialogue. I made the progression of the game similar to a series of scenes. There are checkpoints in between dates and date selections with random interludes either from Mina, mysterious third parties[friends, other characters, etc...], or someone the player's character drew up. This game has 32 endings. A lot of them are creative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583574/c338c1e6c532c05b8652d5761bb290fb578594f8.jpg[/img]

I call it fast love dating or something like that. I guess this game emulates a fast-paced, feral relationship that lasted briefly but impactfully. It's definitely experimental for me, but I'm sure you'll love the dialogue and humor. A lot of the people really liked Liminal Void's writing so I wanted my next effort to be a more straightforward but unique experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583574/7bb53cd3d43ec36a32cd2fb5f3e38c2d410daecd.jpg[/img]

So what's the writing style? I guess on surface Mina does come off as "one of those" types of gals. But behind it shes's sweet? Nope, she's flawed, and she's very open about it. She will suddenly act cute. She will switch personality. And you will assume that she must be some sort of program bugging out instead of an actual woman. But I wrote it very dialogue heavy. Mina talks directly to you throughout the whole game. There is no boring filler or skipping. This is a fast-paced straightforward visual novel.

I'll be updating a lot before and after release. This game is going to come out May 23/May24 depending where you are. I am also giving a panel the same weekend.

Please wishlist the game if you're into landmine girls or anything like that!
